The '''Registry Office''' was an organization that managed [[starship]]s. After the inception of spacecraft licenses under the Registry Office, noncombat starships were required to carry [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielding]] [[Deflector shield generator|generators]] of at least grade two strength.<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>
